tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm ivory in light, near-black in dark. The ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, menus, dialogs. Sits on canvas, separated by a line hairline.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table headers, code blocks, segmented-control tracks, sidebar background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (1px). Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, outlined buttons. Holds 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on canvas, surface and surface-sunken. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, helper text. On canvas, surface and surface-sunken (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside inputs (on surface) and disabled labels. Never for content people must read.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the primary button label, inverted chips, tooltips.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The one accent. Links, selected states, active nav marker, key numbers. As text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken or brass-soft.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brass text: selected rows, active nav item, highlight badges.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on a brass fill (the accent button, at most once per view).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons, on the surfaces or success-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and icons, on the surfaces or warning-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: field error text, error borders, delete buttons. On the surfaces or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error badges and banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset by a 2px canvas gap. 5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and sheets.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing and empty-state pages.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section openers, big numbers in editorial layouts.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: App page titles and dialog titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and section headings in the app.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every detail is chosen, nothing is decoration.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, table cells, input values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button labels, nav items.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above titles; set in uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Codes, IDs, keyboard shortcuts, tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; input and button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding, hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, focus ring corners on text links, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, large media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggles, avatars, pill segmented controls.

shadow.note: Borders first. Shadows are reserved for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards that need lift on canvas (rare: prefer a line border).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets only.

size.note: Fixed control heights keep rows aligned across buttons, inputs and tabs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons, inputs and tabs in dense tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero calls to action and touch-first forms.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar height.
